|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">昆虫型種族のヴラティックスが何世紀も以前に発明した画期的な医療技術。ゼラチン状の赤いバクタの粒子が合成溶液中に散在しており、治療用バクテリアの媒介物質となる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Bacta Tank.

'''Card text:'''
Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of the table. A non-droid character just lost may be moved here instead of the Lost Pile. Holds 1 'patient' at a time. During your deploy phase, you may use X Force to take the 'patient' into hand. X = the 'patient's' deploy cost.

'''Lore:'''
A revolutionary medical technique invented centuries ago by the insectoid Vratix. Gelatinous red bacta particles are suspended in a synthetic solution and serve as a medium for healing bacteria.
